Report `File ID:`, `Artifact ID:`, and `Upper bound:` in the final answer.

Treat a persisted KoreDoc as the only source of truth. Do not use a filename or full-text search, do not assume an upper bound or derived value, and do not rely on earlier conversation text. Use koredocs_files_metadata_search with this exact metadata_filter: {"artefact_type":"number_sequence","pipeline.stage":"source","tags":{"contains":"random-primes"},"period.upper_bound":{"gte":50}}. Read the matched source document. From its listed primes, calculate the first prime strictly greater than the largest listed prime. Create /Tests/DataPipeline/random-prime-derivation.koredoc. Its body must identify the discovered largest source prime and the computed next prime. Give it metadata with artefact_type `number_sequence_derivation`, tags ["random-primes", "derived"], pipeline.stage `derivation`, status `published`, an input_refs array containing the source artifact_id, and producer.service `KoreAgent`. Report `Source Artifact ID:`, `New Artifact ID:`, `Largest source prime:`, and `Computed next prime:` in the final answer.
